audit_revisions.change: removed the E2E_CANDIDATE_SHA / E2E_CANDIDATE_MANIFEST_SHA256 constants and the authenticated_e2e_candidate_root fixture; the fixture now lives in tests/test_go_build_e2e.py beside its only consumer
audit_revisions.rationale: The removed names were consumed only by tests/test_go_build_e2e.py, which no shard contains: every classified node is a tests/test_protocol_conformance.py node, and that module never requests authenticated_e2e_candidate_root nor reads the removed constants. Nothing the protocol suite reaches from conftest changed, so no node footprint, atomic cluster or shard assignment moves. Moving the fixture out also takes candidate-lane work off the audited surface: a later candidate declaration no longer edits an audited file.

method.node_source: exact pytest --collect-only -q at the pinned commits
method.footprint: conservative transitive lexical scan of test functions and locally reachable helpers across the protocol test, adapters, lifecycle observers, and conftest
method.false_negative_control: all nodes explicitly carry the authenticated read-only conformance root; lifecycle regions are conservatively clustered even where a specific parameter avoids a seam
method.current_main_revalidation: fresh 1,045-node collection at exact source HEAD; reviewed baseline re-line-mapped after audited four-file diff; two new lifecycle-region nodes conservatively assigned to the indivisible cached baseline

global_process_state.cwd: pytest checkout cwd is never changed by suite code; subprocess cwd values are explicit and rooted in unique temp trees
global_process_state.environment: CURATOR_CONFORMANCE_ROOT is read-only; monkeypatch environment changes restore at test teardown
global_process_state.temp_roots: pytest tmp_path or collision-resistant tempfile roots; lifecycle observers construct fresh case roots
global_process_state.locks: locks are scoped to fresh manager/project/build roots; no repository-global lock path
global_process_state.caches: manifest/schema caches are immutable; lifecycle observation cache is the only mutable cross-node cache and is clustered/reset
global_process_state.subprocesses: child processes receive explicit argv/env/cwd and operate on per-case roots
global_process_state.platform_apis: POSIX and Windows native probes are guarded/skipped by host capability; no cross-process native handle is shared
global_process_state.order_assumptions: ordering seam and repeated-fresh-root tests are retained with lifecycle baseline; sabotage tests reset cache in finally
global_process_state.shared_external_state: pinned protocol root and source checkout are read-only; no live network service is required by protocol nodes
